preconditions.description: a and b are integers within the range [1, 1000]
Coordinates of points A and B are within the range [-10000, 10000]
Number of trenches n is within the range [1, 1000]

preconditions.expression: all(len(trench) == 4 for trench in trenches) and all(-10000 <= x <= 10000 for trench in trenches for x in trench[:2])
preconditions.description: Each trench is represented by four integers (x1, y1, x2, y2) with coordinates in [-10000, 10000]

preconditions.expression: all((x1 == x2 or y1 == y2) for trench in trenches)
preconditions.description: Each trench is either horizontal or vertical (axis-aligned)

preconditions.expression: all(abs(x2 - x1) + abs(y2 - y1) <= b for trench in trenches)
preconditions.description: Length of each trench (Manhattan distance) does not exceed b

preconditions.expression: not any((Ax == x1 and Ay == y1) or (Ax == x2 and Ay == y2) or (Bx == x1 and By == y1) or (Bx == x2 and By == y2) for trench in trenches)
preconditions.description: Points A and B do not lie on any trench

preconditions.expression: all(not intersects(trench1, trench2) for i in range(len(trenches)) for j in range(i + 1, len(trenches)) for trench1, trench2 in [(trenches[i], trenches[j])])
preconditions.description: No two trenches intersect (helper: intersects(x1,y1,x2,y2, x3,y3,x4,y4) checks if two axis-aligned segments intersect)

postconditions.description: Output is either -1 (impossible) or a non-negative time (≤ 1e6) representing the minimum time required

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' implies exists_path_with_time(Ax, Ay, Bx, By, a, b, trenches, float(stdout))
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, there exists a valid path from A to B within the computed time, respecting laser constraints (helper: exists_path_with_time checks feasibility)

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (stdout != '-1' and all(not exists_path_with_time(Ax, Ay, Bx, By, a, b, trenches, t) for t in [0, float(stdout) - 1e-6]))
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, no valid path exists for any time strictly less than the computed time (optimality)
